ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 40% high-intensity white pixels localized to the lateral lobes and 60% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central peduncle and medial fluke regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous fields on the distal regions of both lobes; left lobe white field contains vertical black linear intrusions; right lobe white field contains diagonal black striations; central fluke and peduncle are black with high-density white stippling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 82 degrees; bounding-box depth is clearly defined relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations range from 3 to 12 pixels; notable jagged notch on the medial trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the leading edges tapering into sharp, slightly recurved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular clusters of tan/white pixels (barnacles) concentrated on the extreme distal tips and scattered along the inferior trailing edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct parallel vertical rake marks on the white region of the left lobe; diagonal and intersecting linear abrasions on the right lobe white region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible tissue loss/irregular notch on the interior trailing edge of the left lobe; extensive linear rake mark scarring consistent with odontocete interaction visible on both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Fine-grain white stippling (salt-and-pepper pattern) densely overlaid on the black pigment of the central fluke and peduncle.
